visual_plan: style: FLAT skin for the whole reel (same as Ep 0/Ep 2: one series look). Setting: the same generic office as 20 Nov (open cubicles, big wall clock, the manager's glass cabin 'MANAGER', no company name, no logos or brands). Continuity egg: a small sticky note 'SECONDARY ⭐' on Ramesh's monitor (Ep 0 callback). Freeze frames = still + white flash pop + slight desaturation, not a skin switch. No Christmas decor this time except one leftover drooping paper star and the red garland hung on the manager's cabin door (Ep 1 callback).

CAST (same in every frame of Ep 1 and Ep 2, and the same as Ep 0 '10 nimishala late', 20 Nov): RAMESH = RAMESH_OPT from tools/anim2d/cast.md (light-blue untucked shirt, messy hair, light stubble, badge 'RAMESH · STAFF'; his helmet on his desk); MANAGER = MANAGER_OPT (tucked white shirt, maroon tie, thick moustache, bald top + grey temples, paunch, the plain white mug in his LEFT hand). NEW SURESH (not the 15 Nov TL): oiled, shiny side-parted hair with a comb line, a too-tight pale-lavender formal shirt buttoned to the collar with straining buttons, no tie, a small notepad, badge 'SURESH · STAFF', always nodding (bobble nod loop). NEW PRIYA: high ponytail, mustard-yellow top under a navy cardigan, small gold hoops, a pen behind her ear, a clipboard when she hosts the games, badge 'PRIYA · STAFF'. EXTRAS (silent / chorus only): the 20 Nov colleagues — pink-kurta woman with a bun, green-shirt man with glasses, orange-shirt man with a moustache. Gopi: corner cut-out for his lines only.

Intro 0.0-0.6 s (no voice): text hook 'Manager vs Team: 3 Games 🎮' from frame 1. Villain entry: the manager walks down the aisle in slow-mo, tie flapping in a wind that shouldn't exist, mug steaming, low angle.
L1: DHOOM punch-in on 'ఛాలెంజ్!'; a game-show scoreboard drops: 'MANAGER 0 · TEAM 0'.
L2-L3: Ramesh innocent; the manager's chest-out boast with mock-heroic rays; on the 'ting', a close-up of Ramesh's small secret smile (one eyebrow).
L4 Game 1: card 'GAME 1: HONESTY TEST'; Priya with her clipboard, pen pointing; the manager gulps.
L5: the manager tugs his tie, a sweat drop; chip 'Let's take it offline 🙃'; crickets.
L6: Ramesh dry; chip 'OFFLINE LIFE: 404 NOT FOUND'; laugh; scoreboard ticks TEAM +1.
L7 Game 2: card 'GAME 2: BLINDFOLD'; FOLLOW button pops in the corner and is tapped (the silent follow beat); Suresh ties a black blindfold on the manager.
L8: arms out, shuffling; chip 'PENDING APPRAISALS ⏳'; DONK into the water cooler.
L9: Priya's clue; chip 'HIKE 🚫 STUCK HERE'.
L10: Suresh, nodding hard, points 'Straight!' at the glass cabin door; the manager walks face-first into it: BOINNG, the glass wobbles, slow-mo replay, FAAAH #1, cartoon birds circle his head.
L11 Game 3: card 'GAME 3: SILENCE'; a big stopwatch 01:00 starts.
L12: two ticks in, he explodes, pointing at Ramesh then Suresh; the stopwatch stops at 00:58 with a red buzzer flash; FAAAH #2 with a flat red burst.
L13: an 'OUT!' stamp over the manager; scoreboard TEAM +1.
L14: unashamed, chest out; then he looks around fishing for praise.
L15: the team in unison 'మీరే సార్!'; confetti; the manager does a little victory dance holding the mug like a trophy; scoreboard flips to 'MANAGER 1' with a fake sparkle. Then silence.

L16 punch: Ramesh turns to the camera (close-up, the dancing manager blurred behind); on 'ఓడిపోయారు!' FREEZE FRAME on the manager mid-dance + Ramesh's knowing look, white flash; text 'GAME: MANAGER 🏆 · మనసుల్లో: TEAM ❤️' over the still; comedy sting + laugh.
